name: Brex Corporate Card

apr.notes: APR not stated on product page. Brex corporate card is designed to be paid in full; no personal guarantee required.

fx_fee.notes: Page mentions local currency cards to avoid foreign exchange fees, but no specific FX fee percent stated for US card.

credit_required.notes: No personal credit score required. Underwriting based on business financials including revenue, amount raised, or cash balance.

base_rate.description: Earn 1x points on all other eligible purchases.

categories.label: 7x points on rideshare (e.g. Uber, Lyft, taxis)
4x points on flights and prepaid hotels booked through Brex Travel

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem for cash back, statement credits, gift cards, travel, or transfers. Higher category multipliers (the 'Brex Exclusive' tier) apply when the card balance is paid daily; card-limit/eligibility conditions apply.

benefits.title: No personal guarantee
benefits.description: Brex does not require a personal guarantee. Underwriting is based on business financials, so founders' personal credit isn't used or reported.

benefits.title: Worldwide card acceptance
benefits.description: Physical and virtual cards issued on Mastercard network, with acceptance in 210+ countries and territories.

benefits.title: Credit limits that grow with you
benefits.description: Get a card limit that keeps pace with your business based on financial factors such as revenue or dollars raised. Limits up to 30x higher than traditional business credit cards.

benefits.title: Unlimited virtual cards
benefits.description: Issue unlimited virtual corporate cards instantly with embedded controls that work at the category, merchant, and transaction level.

benefits.title: Built-in expense management
benefits.description: Brex cards automatically collect itemized receipts compliant with IRS or local tax laws, generate memos, and categorize to the right GL and/or project.

benefits.title: Local cards in 50+ countries
benefits.description: Brex cards can be issued in more countries and currencies than any other, enabling local operations anywhere. Local currency cards and statements to avoid foreign exchange fees.

benefits.title: Enterprise-grade security
benefits.description: Chip and PIN, fraud protection, and more on World Elite Mastercard. SOC 1 Type I, SOC 2 Type II, and PCI-DSS compliant.

notes: Verified against the official Brex product and rewards pages on 2026-07-25. Brex is a pay-in-full corporate charge card (no personal guarantee); type set to 'charge' and segment 'corporate'. No annual fee ($0). Reward multipliers: 7x rideshare, 4x Brex Travel (flights & prepaid hotels), 3x restaurants, 2x recurring software, 1x on everything else — the higher 'Brex Exclusive' tiers apply to the daily-payment card. APR and US FX-fee percent are not published on the product page (left null).
